subject.title: fix(gateway): bound BOOT.md file read size

question: Should a `BOOT.md` exceeding 16 MiB be treated as empty and skipped, or should gateway boot report a visible size-limit failure?
rationale: Both outcomes prevent unbounded allocation, but they differ in compatibility and diagnosability; the repository has no cited shipped size-limit contract that resolves this product choice automatically.

options.title: Accept bounded skip
options.body: Keep the current PR behavior, accepting that pathological oversized files no longer execute and are reported as an empty skip.

options.title: Fail visibly on size
options.body: Preserve the 16 MiB bound but surface a distinct failed outcome so operators know their boot instructions were not executed.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded skip
recommendation.body: Keep the current PR behavior, accepting that pathological oversized files no longer execute and are reported as an empty skip.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged per-agent gateway boot path and are the strongest available history-based owner for its startup semantics.
